classification.action_defect: Flag the tested packing context for exclusion from subsequent accuracy-qualified placement until the context difference is understood; retain source identity and isolated evidence.
classification.action_equivalent: Mark only the tested patch/template/observable/context as within the coarse packing tolerance under the observed calibration.
classification.action_unresolved: Retain the interval and withhold a packing-preservation conclusion. The protocol authorizes zero automatic repeat acquisitions.
classification.input: Use the existing measured family endpoint interval [L,U] divided by R; keep original alpha and sample denominators.
classification.unresolved: Every other qualified interval, including equality at a boundary. Failure to detect a defect establishes neither equivalence nor preservation.
classification.withheld: The production collector withholds the family, source/QPY/count/provenance checks fail, or calibrated comparison context is unqualified.

geometry_and_contrast_scope: Recommend the practical packing audit as the primary new admission protocol. Retain class-return, edge visibility, dark leakage and rank-norm estimates with their original intervals and interpretation limits. Introduce zero additional application-specific visibility/dark/norm acceptance thresholds; original zero-null rejection establishes sign only, and this protocol establishes neither exact zeros nor rank/topology nor calibrated amplitudes.
incremental_purpose: The existing dynamic folded and correction jobs interrogate recorded-bit feedback on different physical histories. They contain zero same-patch packed-versus-isolated static box-kite, walk, Design C or rank-sector controls, so they cannot answer these context-accuracy questions. The retained static acquisition supplies 37 scored context controls plus complete labeled geometric coverage; repeated ideal laws are implementation/context coverage rather than additional algebraic discoveries.
normalization: For each paired control with identical score w, R=max(w)-min(w), Delta=E[w]_packed-E[w]_isolated, d=Delta/R. Constant offsets cancel. Bernoulli controls have R=1; weighted Design C controls retain their own R.
objective: Identify practical same-patch packing defects and classify tolerable context changes for the exact retained controls; supply measured geometric maps with explicit unresolved outcomes.
operational_effect_interpretation: For g=(w-min(w))/R in [0,1], |E_p[g]-E_q[g]| <= TV(p,q). A certified normalized packing defect greater than 0.10 therefore lower-bounds total-variation distance between the two labeled measured outcome distributions by greater than 0.10. Scalar equivalence gives no upper bound on total-variation distance or quantum-state/channel distance.

prospective_identity_renewal.historical_verification_scope: The unchanged read_only_verification object retains the original generator observations for the original prepared records. The renewal receipts identify the new source- and calibration-bound cases separately.
prospective_identity_renewal.submission_authority: The artifact supplies prospective analysis binding only. The correction decision, reviewed merged code, fresh case revalidation, campaign accounting and user-authorized execution conditions remain required.

rank_units.limit: The probability tolerance does not become a uniform path-wide norm or norm-squared tolerance. Transform a single probability interval monotonically for display; taking the square root of a contrast interval does not produce a norm-difference interval.

read_only_verification.measured_boundary: All files in the frozen experiment source manifest, requirements.txt, and both prepared record.json files. Other checkout surfaces were outside this observation.

assumptions: independent stationary bounded observations within each PUB repetition stream
arbitrary dependence across components within a physical shot
union bounds across separate PUBs without a cross-PUB independence assumption
common qualified calibration and comparison context as enforced by collection
statistical_scope.claim: Every practical label is a deterministic statement implied by the existing simultaneous two-sided intervals. No additional hypothesis tests, alpha redistribution or selected-subset recalculation is used.
statistical_scope.power_proof: For positive d, missed positive classification requires a downward score error of at least |d|-0.10-h. Allocate beta/2 to each one-sided mean deviation and apply Hoeffding plus a union bound. Reverse signs for negative d. The result uses score-range normalization and requires no independence across the two PUBs.
statistical_scope.power_statement: Endpointwise conservative detection guarantee only. Let h be normalized interval half-width and n1,n2 the two PUB counts. For beta=0.2, r=sum_i sqrt(log(2/beta)/(2*n_i)); true |d| >= 0.10+h+r suffices for at least 80 percent probability of the correct practical-defect label. Equivalence power and joint detection power are unclaimed.

tolerance_rationale: The owner-selected coarse engineering tolerance allows at most one tenth of a declared single-arm score range. This is a prospective acceptance specification, not a theorem, literature-derived hardware guarantee, or a tolerance widened to make every control pass.
underresolution_interpretation: The dimension-16 Design C weighted control has normalized half-width 0.11200601629405729, exceeding tolerance 0.10. Every future interval under the frozen allocation is too wide for equivalence, but sufficiently large practical defects remain detectable. Its tolerance and 1024/4096 allocation remain unchanged.
